page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. It does not feature any integrated GPU hardware. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the dedicated 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon processor, this instance is designed for compute-focused workloads that require consistent CPU performance without massive memory footprints. It is suitable for lightweight compute tasks, microservices, and small-scale web serving where dedicated CPU resources are required but local storage and high memory capacities are not necessary.
